name: gloomy_octopus
description: Gloomy octopus (Octopus tetricus) resting on the bottom, facing right: grey-brown #7a6b5e body with fine pale speckle and dark mottles, a white ring around each eye (bar pupils, heavy lids, not cute), mantle raised behind, eight medium arms spread on the bottom with curled tips and pale suckers. Anchor bottom-centre; ~x -350..350, y -375..+20.
